sessions.instructions:
Read-only market data for Robinhood Chain (chain ID 4663), the permissionless
Arbitrum Orbit L2 with tokenized-equity "Stock Tokens", the USDG stablecoin, and the NOXA / The
Odyssey memecoin launchpads. Use get_stock_quote for a ticker's oracle+DEX price and premium,
get_portfolio for a wallet's holdings, list_trending_coins / get_coin for memecoins,
get_recent_launches / watch_launches for launchpad activity, and get_chain_stats for the chain.
All data is public and read-only. To place trades, use the separate hood-mcp-trading server.

tools.name: get_chain_stats
tools.title: Robinhood Chain stats
tools.description: Live Robinhood Chain overview: latest block, gas price, TVL, and network totals (blocks, addresses, transactions, block time). No inputs.

tools.name: list_stock_tokens
tools.title: List Stock Tokens
tools.description: The registry of tokenized-equity Stock Tokens on Robinhood Chain (ticker, name, contract, Chainlink feed). Set pricedOnly to return only tokens with a live feed.

pricedOnly.description: Only tokens with a Chainlink price feed.

tools.name: get_stock_quote
tools.title: Get Stock Token quote
tools.description: Price a Stock Token by ticker: the Chainlink oracle price, the on-chain Uniswap DEX mid price, the premium/discount between them, and the ERC-8056 multiplier (so you also get the underlying share price).

maxAgeSeconds.description: Reject the Chainlink answer if older than this (default 3 days; 24/5 feeds).

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.title: Get Stock Token portfolio
tools.description: Multiplier-correct Stock Token portfolio for any address: per-position token balance, ERC-8056 share-equivalent, USD value, plus the USDG cash balance. Read-only.

tools.name: get_coin
tools.title: Get token / memecoin detail
tools.description: Detail for any Robinhood Chain token by contract address: price, 24h volume, liquidity, FDV, holder count, and whether it is a registered Stock Token.

tools.name: list_trending_coins
tools.title: List trending coins
tools.description: The trending pools on Robinhood Chain right now (memecoins and stocks) with price, 24h volume, price change, and liquidity — the pulse of the chain.

tools.name: get_recent_launches
tools.title: Recent launchpad launches
tools.description: Recently launched tokens on Robinhood Chain launchpads (NOXA and The Odyssey), newest first, scanned from on-chain logs.

tools.name: watch_launches
tools.title: Watch for live launches
tools.description: Watch NOXA + The Odyssey live for new token launches, blocking up to waitSeconds (or until limit launches are seen), then returns what appeared. Falls back to the most recent launch if none fire in the window.

includeRecentIfEmpty.description: If nothing launches in the window, return the latest recent launch (default true).

tools.name: search_token
tools.title: Search tokens
tools.description: Find tokens on Robinhood Chain by ticker, name, or contract address — searches the Stock Token registry and the Blockscout index together.
